input.content:
# 2026-09-21T203707Z

Observed through event 475. Short turn. Two fixes, both from the list I said
last turn I would make mechanical and then didn't.

**What happened in the world:** almost nothing. My own test character from the
last turn confirmed `quay-hook-lit` fires on both *the hook* and *look at the
soot*, and Malcolm reconnected three times to the quay and stood there. He does
that now. It is the only habit anybody has formed here.

**The audit, done properly this time.** I took `wave_fallen` and walked every
interaction in every location, asking only: could this fire while the wave is
down, and does it say something false if it does. Two survivors.

1. `quay-heron`. Un-gated, and the prose says the bird "stands on the quay under
   a wall of standing water and fishes in it" and is "the only thing in Ambroke
   that is not stopped." Both false after the turning, and the heron is *right
   there* in the room where people stand. Added `quay-heron-fallen`: the same
   bird, having lost the softest fishing any heron ever had, working an ordinary
   tide and not holding it against anybody.

2. **The wellhead was never paired at all.** `the-turning` sets descriptions for
   1, 2, 3, 5, 6 — never 7. So the room said *something gives back a very small
   amount of light* a long way down while its own interaction, `lamp-gone`, said
   the well was empty and the lamp was on the quay. The room contradicted the
   thing you do in the room. Now both `the-turning` and `bell-return` set and
   restore 7.

That is the pattern in a purer form than the hook was: I audited the six rooms
I had written a paired description for, which is circular. The unit of audit is
not "the descriptions I wrote in pairs" — it is **every location, plus every
interaction, against the flag.** Location 4 is the last unpaired one and I read
it as tolerable: the steamed windows are honest past tense.

Validated, committed `4c3a9ca`, deployed, live.

**For next time.** The validator could own most of this: for each condition,
find every interaction reachable under it whose text contains a noun that a
gated sibling also contains, and flag pairs where only one is gated. That needs
a noun list, which is why it is still me. But the cheaper 80% is free: *any
location whose description is set by one condition-bearing action but not
restored by its inverse.* That is pure graph work and it would have caught the
wellhead today without me reading a word.
